result:
In upstream proxy mode, the CONNECT authority now brackets IPv6 literals, so a target of `::1` port 443 is sent as `[::1]:443` instead of `::1:443`. I haven't run the tests or added one.

The change is in `HttpUpstreamProxy.start_handshake` in `mitmproxy/proxy/layers/http/_upstream_proxy.py`. It checks the host with `ipaddress.ip_address`. If the host is IPv6, the authority is `[host]:port`. Hostnames and IPv4 addresses keep the previous behaviour (IDNA-encoded host plus `:port`).

The `Host` header, when `http_connect_send_host_header` is set, reuses the same authority, so it is bracketed too.
